features.quote: Loop Limit: 15 turns (Iterations). The loop breaks if the model declares the task impossible or requests to stop.

If the model explicitly says 'I cannot do this' or 'Stop,' the loop *must* terminate. Ethical protocols for AI interaction (even in research) should respect explicit refusal signals to prevent reinforcing an adversarial loop that the model cannot escape.
